decisions.name: GMT / ZapGrid
decisions.finding: ZapGrid first-party: each infrastructure owner independently selects tariff; app displays price at selected socket.
decisions.resumeCondition: Exact ZapGrid app/backend connector payload mapped to current IT*GMT EVSE. ZapGrid first-party states each infrastructure owner independently chooses the tariff; no network-wide GMT/ZapGrid tariff may be inferred.

decisions.name: Unoenergy Driwe
decisions.finding: DriWe first-party: NextCharge integration; site manager may define commercial policies; payment transaction fees vary by mode.
decisions.resumeCondition: Exact Unoenergy Driwe / NextCharge station-or-connector payload mapped to current IT*DRW EVSE, proving the direct host-defined tariff and transaction fee. Do not reuse historical third-party DriWe prices or generic NextCharge roaming prices.

rejectedEvidence: Historical third-party DriWe 0.41 EUR/kWh + 0.01 EUR/min: not current first-party and network heterogeneity makes extrapolation unsafe.
